rules: start at bottom centre: floor 1 = 2x2 FOYER with the front door; floors 2-5 = 1x1 STAIRWELL landing (arrival)
skeleton by plan: manor (gallery corridor across + 2 wing corridors north), ring (corridor ring), cross (north spine + cross corridor + side spurs)
fill: repeatedly place the largest room (2x2 > 2x1/1x2 > 1x1) that touches a corridor; theme from that floor's list, capped per theme
symmetry: every placement is mirrored into the other wing (same size, different theme); if that fails, the mirrored footprint is filled with smaller rooms
doors: corridor-corridor arch; each room gets 1 door (2 for multi-cell) to a touching corridor; 35% of room-room neighbours get an extra door, half of them one-way back toward the start

roles: stairs = farthest room by door distance (or the farthest 1x1 becomes a STAIRWELL), boss on floor 5 (largest far room), elites 0/1/1/2/2 in multi-cell rooms, then treasure, shrine, dock, shop (floor 2+); the rest combat
treasure doors are locked (key from the floor elite)
